    {
      "id": "user_6",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the constant 0xffffffff.",
      "asserted_values": ["0xffffffff"],
      "confidence": 0.95

  ],
  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint32_t fn_08(const uint8_t *in, size_t len) {\n  uint32_t result = 0xffffffff;\n  if (len != 0) {\n    const uint8_t *ptr = in;\n    while (ptr != in + len) {\n      result ^= *ptr;\n      uint32_t temp = result;\n      for (int i = 8; i != 0; i--) {\n        temp = -(temp & 1) & 0xf7179bf5 ^ temp >> 1;\n      }\n      ptr++;\n    }\n    return ~result;\n  }\n  return 0;\n}"
}
